values.doc: The customer closed the payment window or the session timed out.

values.doc: The customer cancelled the payment on the PayGlocal page.

values.doc: The customer timed out on the 3-D Secure authentication page.

values.name: GENERAL_DECLINE
values.doc: The payment was declined by PayGlocal's risk engine.
